title: Chapter 444
paragraphs: Chapter 444
127. To the Black King's Group (5)
The Black Knight he had encountered in the hallway came to mind.
'At the entrance of the reception room, he had definitely agreed to meet the leader of the Black King's Group in the morning.'
In a typical case, one would think it would be a process of drafting a request contract and then having a suitable social time, but it was the Black Knight, not someone else.
'If the deal had been concluded, there's no way someone like the Black Knight would be hanging around here. It's not such a leisurely place.'
He was sure of it. Valkas had not yet accepted Joshua's request brought by the Black Knight.
Nevertheless, there were plenty of reasons why the Black King's Group would not accept Jin's request.
In the current world situation, a person like Jin Runcandel was like a poisoned chalice.
If you drink it recklessly, there's a high chance of becoming an enemy with the real 'supreme power holders.'
Jin might be a superstar among superstars, but whether he could break down the solid walls of rulers was uncertain.
No, unless someone was close to Jin or knew him well, no one thought so.
Most people thought that someday, Jin would eventually collapse or be absorbed by a larger star.
No matter how brilliant Jin's achievements and results have been so far, miracles always come to an end.
The majority of people in the world couldn't even imagine or be confident in continuing miracles.

Still, people generally believed that 'Joshua Runcandel' would be the next master of the Sword Garden, and that perception was equally applied to people like Valkas Kran, who were well beyond the scope of ordinary people.
'He doesn't want to take my request and earn Joshua's resentment.'
Not only Joshua.
Through the 'Holy Kingdom incident,' Jin left an indelible stain on Zipfel, and recently there were rumors that he was not on good terms with Vermont's royal family.

It was because the Emperor had only given gold after meeting Jin. Moreover, the Emperor even ordered Vermont's newspapers not to cover his meeting with Jin on the front page. It wasn't a serious matter.
In other words, Jin was not on good terms with the next head of Runcandel, Zipfel, or Vermont. If he got involved in something wrong, it wouldn't be surprising to face some terrible consequences.
Valkas summed up all these reasons in a single phrase, 'you're a step late.' He expressed his clear refusal without offending the other party.
Joshua also didn't directly demand 'do not help Jin' and didn't hurt Valkas' pride. He just subtly warned him by sending the Black Knight here.
Both were showing their political savvy as experienced and powerful people.
'I can't be reckless while I'm alone in this situation.'
He was slightly annoyed but had to look for an opportunity. It was a bad way to be unyielding in rejection, and it only had a negative impact.
To change Valkas' mind, there needed to be one sure card. He had to become Jin's tentative ally, even at the risk of all those dangers. 'Tikan's protection' couldn't be considered a simple request.
At the moment, there was no such card.
Jin didn't know much about a person named Valkas Kran, and he wasn't very cooperative either, so the chances of finding such a card in a short period of time were low.
Zepherin.
Although there was information that the troublemaker of the Black King's group might be a demon dragon, it wasn't very valuable.
Investigating her without certainty and finding her innocent could cause serious side effects.
'Maybe I should try to capture the Black King's group after they grow their power a bit more and Joshua and Zipfel's true colors are fully revealed.'
He quickly reached a conclusion.
He didn't come here with high expectations in the first place. Jin knew his background well.
Of course, Jin was confident.
In the near future, the Black King's group would either come looking for him first, or there would be a day when they regretted not advancing today's conversation further.
'I should go find Amella, the mercenary of the Gaipa Army. Seeing that the Black Knight is here, he must have already sent someone to her.'
For Joshua, it was a meaningful blow to Jin after a long time.
Although it wasn't a fatal blow, it was annoying enough, like a small thorn stuck in the sole of his foot.
If both the Black King's group and the mercenaries were gone, protecting Tikan would rely too much on Hidden Palace.
"If it's too late, there's nothing we can do."
As Jin spoke with a calm voice, Valkas narrowed his eyes.
"Ho, surprisingly, you back off easily."
"It seems that the rumors about me that have reached Lord Valkas are not very good. Seeing that you use the modifier 'surprisingly'."
"Well, it's not that. There are many stories that you can achieve whatever you want... Especially, the atmosphere among the 3rd Army guys is that they like you."
Kolkolkol...
Valkas took out a glass from the drawer, poured some alcohol, and spoke.
There was no need to talk about work, so let's just have a light drink together. Valkas was showing his favor in his own way.
Although he couldn't get the request, he didn't dislike Jin himself. Valkas even thought that if Jin had been from the 2nd generation instead of the 12th, he could have joined hands with him anytime.
"Thank you, Lord Valkas."
"Would the Black Dragon like a drink as well? It's a good drink."
"Yeah, give it to me."
The glasses of the three people gently collided, making a pleasant sound.
Jin thought the situation wasn't too bad. The request had already soured before he even mentioned it, so it wouldn't have been strange if he had left without exchanging a single word with him.
"Our mercenaries who have some connections with dragons say that Lord Murakan was once the strongest existence in the world."
Despite being the leader of the Black King's group, Valkas did not forget simple ways to please those with higher status.
It was intentional that he first spoke to Murakan in a somewhat irreverent tone. Rather, after slightly lowering expectations, the conversation became more enjoyable.
"Definitely, in the sky. I am the strongest and the best of all time."
"Oh, so the stories of those dragons were true after all. But you seem to have had rivals on the ground."
"Rivals, yes, there were a few who could be called that. It was impossible to clearly determine who was stronger. If we had fought to the end, I think I would have won."
"If it were the days when I was full of energy, I would have challenged Lord Murakan even now. It's not easy to meet a strong and historical existence."
"Well... in my time, someone like you would have been somewhat competitive."
"Hehe, that's high praise."
Murakan refilled his empty glass. He was satisfying the other's superiority without belittling himself too much.
'Among all the nearly strongest humans I've met, he has the best social skills.'
As for personal power, Valkas was already a superhuman who had reached 10 stars long ago.
Such superhumans usually didn't show this kind of behavior.
They didn't need to care about anyone's opinion, and they were confident that no stronger person or force could touch them easily.
Valkas was different from other superhumans. He was still cautiously walking the line between giant forces as a neutral party, even though he was in a position to do the same as other superhumans.
The reason was none other than this:
Black King's group leader Valkas Kran cared terribly for his members.
Valkas believed that with just a little effort, his members wouldn't have to be meaninglessly sacrificed in the fights between giant forces.
Jin accurately saw through Valkas' feelings.
It wasn't difficult. If it weren't for that reason, it would be an attitude that could never come from someone like Valkas.
'I see why he started drinking with us.'
Then, Jin began to realize the meaning of this drinking party.
Surely, this drinking party wouldn't stop until the morning sun rose or until Joshua's Black Knight returned to this reception room.
As Joshua subtly implied to Valkas by sending the Black Knight, not to get involved with Jin.
Valkas also had the intention to show the Black Knight the sight of the three of them happily drinking together, expressing his thoughts.
For now, he wouldn't go against your wishes, but he would continue to pay attention to the growth of the 12th generation.
That was the message Valkas wanted to convey to Joshua.
Jin nodded internally as he thought about it.
'Even though it's just a one-night encounter, he's a person I can learn from.'
Jin naturally joined the conversation and started drinking. The conversation was mainly led by Murakan, with Jin and Valkas chiming in.

Murakan's thoughts on the best warriors, magicians, most prosperous times, peaceful times, the biggest difference between dragons and humans, life and death, apples and watermelons, the most beautiful beasts, and so on.
While various topics were flowing along with the stream of consciousness, the conversation about Zephyrin began around ten in the morning.
"How on earth did that strange guy join this group? The little guy said the Black King's group is the world's best mercenary group."
"He may look a bit clumsy, but his swordsmanship is superb. He even taught himself, so I thought he was quite a genius."
"What? He's good with a sword? And he's a genius?"
"He lacks aura, so he can't fully show his destructive power. It seems like he has a constitution where aura doesn't accumulate well. I think he's a strange and peculiar guy in many ways."
Eek! Coincidentally, Zephyrin entered the reception room at that moment. He was carrying the same axe-sword he had last night on his back.
Next to him was the Black Knight, whom they agreed to meet again in the morning.
His face was hidden by the hood, but he couldn't help but make an unpleasant expression when he saw the drinking table. He hadn't expected Valkas to act like this.
"Leader, I brought the guest!"
"…Yeah, Zephyrin. But I heard that the guest from the 2nd generation of Runcandel was supposed to be brought by the deputy leader. Why are you here?"
"Oh, well."
Zephyrin shrugged his shoulders with his characteristic lively and exaggerated gestures.
Then, Jin, Murakan, and Valkas couldn't help but doubt their eyes at the unfolding scene.
Thud!
Suddenly, Zephyrin's hand pierced through the Black Knight's side.
He had originally aimed for the chest, but due to the Black Knight's reaction, he pierced the side instead.
Her violet nails, which had grown out of nowhere, looked like a poison-coated dagger, and the Black Knight was hurriedly distancing himself from her while coughing up blood.
"Cough, cough…!"
"Do you really need to know? The leader is going to die now anyway."
